comment: Add the tokenBindingCertificate request field for the two-leg Federated Identity Credential (FIC, service-to-service) flow over mTLS Proof-of-Possession: present a binding certificate on the TLS handshake while a client assertion is the credential (jwt-pop assertion type) to obtain an mtls_pop token bound to that certificate [#8698](https://github.com/AzureAD/microsoft-authentication-library-for-js/pull/8698)
